description: Benchmark reference dataset for ship resistance validation. Sources: Roddy 1990 (SUBOFF), ITTC V&V Workshop (DTMB-5415), SIMMAN 2008 (KVLCC2). Geometry records audited by tools/ship_perf/audit_benchmark_geometry.py (v1.1): displacement entries made self-consistent with the stated Cb via the Cb=V/(L*B*T) identity.

cases.source_citation: Roddy, J.D. (1990). 'DARPA SUBOFF Model Experiments', David Taylor Research Center, DTRC-90/012. ITTC Recommended Procedures.

geometry.geometry_note: axisymmetric body of revolution: no beam/draft/Cb; volume not published in DTRC-90/012, gate uses S/(pi*D*L) with S=5.42 m2
